title: Structured-output safeguard: signal-chain tests for JSON-mode + streaming + tool-calls
creator: Alex Rivera
description:
Goal: Validate JSON-mode enforcement and constrained-decode behavior across interleaved streaming responses and tool/function calls. This ticket implements a focused test harness (signal-chain tests) that simulates realistic request flows: short/long prompts, mid-stream tool invocation, partial token truncation, and forced kernel fallbacks. We want deterministic failure modes and clear mappings from failure telemetry to remediation (fallback policies, repair heuristics, and canary gating).

Motivation: Existing suites cover many static and partial-stream cases, but we observed customer incidents where tool calls injected non-JSON fragments and partial streams combined with batching/hedging produced silent schema drift. These tests exercise the runtime + decoder gating + toolcall boundary normalization to ensure graceful degradation and actionable telemetry.

Scope: Implement test definitions, harness runners, and CI jobs that run against the canary runtime image. Include metrics thresholds and automated regression alerts. Do not change production runtime behavior in this ticket; focus is on detection, telemetry, and canary gating criteria. Subsequent tickets will implement automated repair/fallbacks if tests demonstrate regression patterns.
acceptance_criteria: Signal-chain harness implemented and checked into re-runtime test-suite with stable API (sentry-runner v0.9)
CI job ci/structured-output-signalchain runs on every runtime-1.22 canary build and reports pass/fail
Defined telemetry mapping: decoder-failure-code -> alertable SLO; documented runbook for top-3 failure signatures
At least 12 unique scenarios covering: streaming-only, toolcall-midstream, toolcall-poststream, partial-token-termination, hedging-induced interleaving
No false positives on the known-good baseline dataset (baseline dataset id: baseline-json-signal-2025-02)
test_cases: TC-01: Streaming-only well-formed JSON - 3 sequence lengths (short/medium/long) with and without prefix caching; assert full-JSON decode success and no sentinel corrections

TC-02: Mid-stream tool call that returns a non-JSON preface - model expected to emit 'TOOL_CALL_START' sentinel, then resume JSON mode; assert constrained decoder tolerates sentinel and recovers structured output

TC-03: Tool call returns truncated JSON fragment (network cut) - decoder must detect incomplete object and trigger partial-stream repair logic; assert telemetry emits 'partial_stream_incomplete' and test harness retries with regeneration request
TC-04: Hedged requests with interleaved tokens from two model variants - ensure schema gate rejects mixed-origin stream; capture token provenance and fail fast with predefined fallback policy
TC-05: Kernel fallback during generation (quantization kernel swap) while streaming - verify decoder continuity and KV cache alignment; assert no silent schema drift
TC-06: High-latency downstream tool call that delays callback past SLO boundary - test that streaming sentinel keeps JSON enclosure open and runtime can emit graceful 'fallback' variant
TC-07: Adversarial prompt with injected closing braces and non-JSON fragments - assert constrained decoder enforces field types and either repairs or surfaces a structured-output violation metric
TC-08: Canary dataset regression test - run the full 12-scenario sweep against previous stable runtime and new canary; require parity or documented regression with linked issue
